comment: Enters the startup tutorial as a Samurai and searches until hunger interrupts the count, then searches on until nutrition falls below 148. allmain.c moveloop_core() runs the end_turn callback that nhlib.lua tutorial_enter() registered; tutorial_turn() then calls obj.new("blessed food ration"), which reaches objnam.c readobjnam() and rnd_otyp_by_namedesc(), places the ration under the hero, and shows two messages, each followed by --More--. The : command shows the ration.
